questions.question:
Which two signs/numbers need to be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

8 ÷ 2 + 4 = 10
questions.solution:
1) Given expression : 8 ÷ 2 + 4 = 10

Interchanged the sign and number ÷ and +, 8 and 4 -

LHS = 4 + 2 ÷ 8

= 4 + 1 ÷ 4

= 17/4 ≠ R.H.S

2) Given expression : 8 ÷ 2 + 4 = 10

Interchanged the sign ÷ and +

LHS = 8 + 2 ÷ 4

= 8 + 1 ÷ 2

= 17/2 ≠ R.H.S

3) Given expression : 8 ÷ 2 + 4 = 10

Interchanged the sign and number + and ÷, 8 and 2

LHS = 2 + 8 ÷ 4

= 2 + 2

= 4 ≠ R.H.S

4) Given expression : 8 ÷ 2 + 4 = 10

Interchanged the sign and number + and ÷, 2 and 4

LHS = 8 + 4 ÷ 2

= 8 + 2

= 10 = RHS

Hence, ‘ + and ÷, 2 and 4’ is the correct answer.

__
 
• Meaning of** "Some A are B"** in Syllogism - there is *at least one point in A which is in B*.
 
• Meaning of "All A are B" in Syllogism - *each point of A is in B*.
 
• This explains why "some" can be considered as a subset of "all".
 
• Therefore, *if "All A are B" is true, then "some A are B" is always true.*

questions.question: While trying to promote growth by tax cuts as the fiscal policy, which type of policy is the government trying to follow?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Expansionary.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** expansionary policy** aims to stimulate the economy by** boosting demand through monetary and fiscal stimulus.**
 
• Expansionary policy is intended to **prevent or moderate economic downturns and recessions.**
 
• ​The Expansionary fiscal policy involves **reducing taxes or increasing government **spending to increase aggregate demand and production output.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Contractionary policy:**

 
 
• Contractionary policy is a monetary measure referring either** to a reduction in government spending or a reduction in the rate of monetary expansion** by a central bank.
 
• Contractionary policy is the** opposite of expansionary policy.**
 
• It is undertaken to combat rising inflation or other economic distortions created by central banks or government interventions. 
 
 
 
• **Easy money:**
 
 
• **Easy money **is a way for the central bank to build more cash within the economic system.
 
• Easy money occurs when a central bank wants to make money flow between banks more easily.
 
• When banks have access to more money, interest rates charged to customers go down because banks have more money than needed to invest.
 
 
 
• **Tight money:**
 
 
• Tight money usually restrict the money supply and reduces the number of money banks have to lend.
 
• It can also be the result of an increased demand to hold money when the quantity of money remains unchanged.

Speed of train is 50% faster than car

Time taken by train is to cover 60 km = (t - 12.5) minutes or (t - 12.5)/60 hours

Time taken by car to cover 60 km = t minutes or t/60 hours 

**Formula Used :**

Speed = Distance/time 

**Calculations :**

Let the speed of car be S

Speed of train is 50% more than car = S + 50% of S = (3/2)S

Now for train 

⇒ 60 = (3/2)S × (t - 12.5)/60 ...(1)

Now for car 

⇒ 60 = S × (t/60) ...(2)

Solving both equations

value of t = (75/2) minutes or (5/8) hours 

Speed of car = distance/Speed 

⇒ 60/(5/8)

⇒ 96 km/hours 

∴ **The speed of the car is 96 km/hour**

⇒ (t -5/24)h

⇒ 3t - 5/8 = 2t

Now, speed of car = Distance/Time = 60 ÷ 5/8
